name: Caprine
description: electron-updater with verifyUpdateCodeSignature:false — disabled its own Authenticode check.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Caprine uses electron-updater for automatic checks when enabled; its Windows electron-builder configuration sets verifyUpdateCodeSignature to false, while this observation does not characterize verification for other targets.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout.
The explicit verifyUpdateCodeSignature setting is nested under the Windows target; this review does not infer equivalent behavior for macOS or Linux.

original_evidence.text: | Caprine | sindresorhus/caprine | Electron (`electron-updater`) | Y | auto (chk/dl/notify — `autoUpdater.checkForUpdatesAndNotify()` runs immediately at startup, then every 4 hours; installs on user quit/restart per electron-updater default, not forced) | Y | https (GitHub Releases via `electron-updater`'s GitHub provider) | manifest present (`latest*.yml` on GitHub Releases, served over TLS, not independently signed) | hash-from-manifest (electron-updater's standard sha512 check against `latest.yml`) — AND Windows code-signature verification is EXPLICITLY DISABLED | none effective on Windows (see below) / OS-trust-store on macOS (electron-updater macOS path still requires a valid Squirrel.Mac-compatible signed app) | `source/index.ts:17,68-77` (`import {autoUpdater} from 'electron-updater'`; `if (!is.development && config.get('autoUpdate')) { setInterval(...) checkForUpdatesAndNotify(); ... await autoUpdater.checkForUpdatesAndNotify(); }`); `package.json` build config: `"win": { "verifyUpdateCodeSignature": false }` — this explicitly turns off electron-builder/electron-updater's Windows Authenticode publisher-match check on downloaded installers, leaving only the sha512 hash pulled from the same (TLS-only, unsigned) `latest.yml` manifest as the sole integrity check on Windows; `"mac": { "electronUpdaterCompatibility": ">=4.5.2" }`; publish target includes GitHub in `build.snap.publish` |
